items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: He was a guest at that day.

ctx.x: Yeah. When you're playing like that, if you can keep up with the music, you skip. If you miss, yeah, don't miss over there. If you get out, you're out altogether, you see.
This was a, was this Neto? Was that his name? Who? Neto, the trombone player was out. I think it was, yeah.
Now he was a guest at that. He had on his tuxedos and everything. He was a guest at that day.
